     7→/// Transform a `Electra` state into an `Fulu` state.
     8→pub fn upgrade_to_fulu<E: EthSpec>(
     9→    pre_state: &mut BeaconState<E>,
    10→    spec: &ChainSpec,
    11→) -> Result<(), Error> {
    12→    let _epoch = pre_state.current_epoch();
    13→
    14→    let post = upgrade_state_to_fulu(pre_state, spec)?;
    15→
    16→    *pre_state = post;
    17→
    18→    Ok(())
    19→}

    21→fn initialize_proposer_lookahead<E: EthSpec>(
    22→    state: &BeaconState<E>,
    23→    spec: &ChainSpec,
    24→) -> Result<Vector<u64, E::ProposerLookaheadSlots>, Error> {
    25→    let current_epoch = state.current_epoch();
    26→    let mut lookahead = Vec::with_capacity(E::proposer_lookahead_slots());
    27→    for i in 0..(spec.min_seed_lookahead.safe_add(1)?.as_u64()) {
    28→        let target_epoch = current_epoch.safe_add(i)?;
    29→        lookahead.extend(
    30→            state
    31→                .get_beacon_proposer_indices(target_epoch, spec)
    32→                .map(|vec| vec.into_iter().map(|x| x as u64))?,
    33→        );
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    Vector::new(lookahead).map_err(|e| {
    37→        Error::PleaseNotifyTheDevs(format!("Failed to initialize proposer lookahead: {:?}", e))
    38→    })
    39→}

    41→pub fn upgrade_state_to_fulu<E: EthSpec>(

    57→        slot: pre.slot,
